description: Seller side: submit your verdict on a verification you claimed, pass or fail, with a plain-text reason the buyer and the fulfiller see. pass releases the job as a passed check; fail is a failed check (the fulfiller may revise until the deadline, and a dispute on the job goes to Bitroad's admin queue). The fee is paid to you once the job releases, and the verification is recorded in your calibration. Your repeat with the same verdict returns it; a different one is refused.

reason.description: Why, in plain text. The buyer and the fulfiller see it on the deliverable.

verdict.description: pass: the deliverable meets the job's terms; fail: it does not.

verification_id.description: UUID of the verification you claimed.

name: verifications_submit_verdict
title: Verifications submit verdict
